Cost: Varies

Mods: All Ranged Weapons, individual eligibility by weapon category

A plethora of ready-made kits provide everything needed to replace or add receivers, bolts, grips, stocks, and more to any conceivable firearm.

When installed, the Range Table the weapon fires on is modified to match that of the Conversion Kit. The weapon is now compatible with Attachments the weapon category its new Range Table belongs to as long as it still satisfies the Attachment’s usual requirements. The weapon is also now Two-Handed and not Concealable if not already so.

Unless stated otherwise, the weapon’s damage, Autofire Rating, Capacity, used row of the Capacity Chart, and other particulars are unaffected. The weapon now cannot remove or replace any attached Range Table Modification, nor attach any new Range Table Modification while this mod is installed. Available Conversion Kits include:

▶ Assault Kit (Sniper Rifles) ♦ 500eb (Expensive)

Scout Rifle — Battle Rifle

Sniper Rifle — Assault Rifle

Anti-Material Rifle — Marksman Rifle

▶ DMR Kit (Very Heavy Pistols and Assault Rifles) ♦ 750eb (Expensive)

All DMR Kit weapons use the Shoulder Arms Skill to fire if they did not already do so.

Pistol (Any Range)/Carbine — Scout Rifle

Assault Rifle/Battle Rifle — Sniper Rifle

Marksman Rifle — Anti-Material Rifle

▶ Carbine Kit (Very Heavy Pistols and SMGs [All]) ♦ 600eb (Expensive)

Pistol (Any Range)/Subcompact SMG — Carbine

SMG — Assault Rifle

▶ Payload Kit (Grenade/Rocket Launchers) ♦ 1,000eb (V. Expensive)

All Payload Kit weapons deal 1d6 less damage, and explosives fired by them only explode in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 Squares) area. Payload Kit launchers can equip Silencers, but this only silences the initial launch, not the fired explosives themselves.

Grenade Launcher — Scout Rifle

Rocket Launcher — Sniper Rifle

Missile Launcher — Anti-Material Rifle

▶ PDW Kit (Pistols [All]) ♦ 600eb (Expensive)

Snubnose Pistol — Subcompact SMG

Pistol — SMG

Long Barrel Pistol — Carbine

▶ Ramjet Kit (Bows/Crossbows) ♦ 1,000eb (V. Expensive)

Shortbow — Long Barrel Shotgun

Bow — Assault Rifle

Longbow — Scout Rifle

▶ Rifle Kit (Very Heavy Pistols and SMGs [All]) ♦ 750eb (V. Expensive)

All Rifle Kit weapons use the Shoulder Arms Skill to fire if they did not already do so.

Snubnose Pistol/Pistol/Subcompact SMG — Assault Rifle

Long Barrel Pistol/SMG — Battle Rifle

▶ SBR Kit (Assault/Sniper Rifles) ♦ 1,000eb (V. Expensive)

All SBR Kit weapons deal 1d6 less damage in Single Shot to a minimum of 4d6 and have their Autofire Rating reduced by 1 to a minimum of Autofire (3).

Carbine — Snubnose Pistol

Assault Rifle — Subcompact SMG

Battle Rifle — SMG

Marksman/Scout Rifle — Long Barrel Pistol

Sniper/Anti-Material Rifle — Carbine

Attachment slots: 0 (Weapon Mod)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Mod Catalog > Weapon Mods).
